subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear customer, We are pleased to confirm your flight booking for the upcoming trip to Paris. Your flight details are as follows: Departure: April 15th, 2022 at 10:00 AM from JFK Airport Arrival: April 15th, 2022 at 3:00 PM at Charles de Gaulle Airport Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours prior to departure. For any changes or inquiries, please contact our customer service team. We wish you a pleasant journey!
